description: This Kotlin source file defines a fragment class HomeFragment used in an Android application to display the home screen with various sections like banners and content rails, including setup for RecyclerView and mock data generation.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment representing the main home screen layout with sections such as banners and content rails, managing RecyclerView setup and focus behaviors.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data class representing individual media content items with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row of content with a title and list of ContentItems.

methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes view binding.
